title: Specify arrangement evolution
summary: Community hypothesis: describing when layers enter, retreat, widen, or resolve may help a track develop more coherently than asking for a generic dramatic chorus.

build.target: Describe a meaningful progression of instrumentation and dynamics across an original song.
requires: Song sections or estimated section goals
Permission and credits if sending to Suno
outputs: Optionally an audio analysis and listener report
execute: Describe the opening texture, development, peak and resolution in musical actions.
Assign arrivals and withdrawals of instruments or rhythmic density to section boundaries.
Keep vocal pacing and motif continuity explicit without pretending to prescribe exact bar counts.
Generate only if authorized; inspect whether sections repeat and change audibly.
Document the difference between requested narrative and actual arrangement.

applies_when: A song feels static, flat or lacks a satisfying build.
A dramatic chorus needs space and contrast.
avoid_when: Exact orchestral hits must align to a picture; prefer deterministic composition/editing.
No section-level control is available in the selected tool.

operator: Section prose is a soft request, not deterministic scheduling.

stop_when: A reviewable arc exists or the constraints are unresolved.
After bounded generation and human comparison, stop with observed outcome.

checks: Audio sections and listener reports support or contradict the arc.
Link each claim to the specific model/settings used.
